camera_journey.physics: paused; only camera moves; fixed wall-time trajectory

dev_diagnostics.gpu_time_scope: longest instrumented render span; nested passes are not summed
dev_diagnostics.input_latency_scope: synthetic queue to next ECS frame; excludes hardware and display

draw_calls.scope: actual WORLD/grass submissions; excludes Standard PBR, UI and Hanabi

electric_contacts.contact_source: physical route voltage, original animation bounds and TRK wire height

enhanced_scenery.lod: dense near, sparse/lower mid, dither to texture-only far
enhanced_scenery.scope: original TERRTEX green mask; unknown/unclassified content is excluded

render_resources.bindless_material_allocations_scope: Raw PBR allocated_resource_count with the local 0.19.1 aliased-binding fix; occupied slots are distinct from material owner maps and GPU bytes.

residency.basis: measured active-device usage / physical device total

storm.audio_scope: thunders counts audio dispatches; elapsed_thunder_events also records muted events

texture_upload.policy: authored DXT blocks when supported; lossless RGBA fallback
